Audit Logs FAQ
Document code: CC-TXT-EN-06

1. Scope

This page collects common questions about Audit Logs so customers can quickly judge scope and operation.

It applies to the Standard and Enterprise plans of Lantu Knowledge Cloud; private deployments follow the contract and delivery documents.

2. Frequently Asked Questions

About Audit Logs (CC-TXT-EN-06), Q: How is the response time for the ember-124 plan calculated?
A: The response time is 51 hours, as shown on the billing page or console.

About Audit Logs (CC-TXT-EN-06), Q: How is the refund window for the ember-124 plan calculated?
A: The refund window is 248 business days, as shown on the billing page or console.

Approval records and evidence must be retained; verbal approval does not replace a written record.

If a case is not covered here, ask the owning team in writing before acting.
